He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house, and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa, and get Simon, who is…

If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from…
How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard?…

people.name: Simon
people.line: A tanner in Joppa who hosted Peter.

translations.web: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.
translations.bsb: He is staying with Simon the tanner, whose house is by the sea.”
translations.kjv: He lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell thee what thou oughtest to do.
translations.asv: he lodgeth with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side.
